title: When THE VICTOR meets THE DEVIL:
subtitle: The End of the Odyssey

script.text: In the great hall of Ithaca, the suitors lie dead. Their bodies are piled like logs. The floor is slick with blood.
Standing amidst the carnage is Ulysses, the Victor. He holds the bow. He has shot the arrow through the axes. He has made the relation irreversible.

script.speaker: THE CARNAGE
script.text: I have won
, says Ulysses.

script.speaker: THE VICTOR
script.text: I have separated the suitors from the queen. I have separated the parasites from the host. I have restored order
But a noise rises from the corpses. A buzzing. A swarming. From the shadows steps THE DEVIL (representing The Parasite/Evil). He is not a monster; he is a man. He is naked. He is hungry.

script.speaker: THE Devil
script.text: You have not won

script.speaker: THE Devil
script.text: You have only fed me. Look
The corpses begin to move. Not with life, but with lice. With rats. With bacteria. The parasite does not stop. It eats the dead as it ate the living.

script.speaker: THE Devil
script.text: I am the Expansion

script.speaker: THE Devil
script.text: I am the inundation. You think you have purified the house with your arrow? You have only created a feast for the worms. I am the noise that follows the signal. I am the hunger that follows the meal
Ulysses raises his bow.

script.speaker: THE DEVIL
script.text: I will kill you too

script.speaker: THE Devil
script.text: You cannot kill me

script.speaker: THE Devil
script.text: I am the arrow itself. I am the irreversible relation. Every time you separate, every time you cut, you create a new edge for me to inhabit. I am the history you are trying to escape
The hall fills with the din of a thousand voices—beggars at the door, drunkards at the table, the sick in the streets. The noise becomes a roar. The roar becomes a song.

script.speaker: THE Devil
script.text: This book is burnt

script.speaker: THE Devil
script.text: It is a book of Evil. Of noise. Of plague. You wanted to write a philosophy of relations, and you wrote a genealogy of Hell
He points to the door. It creaks open.

script.speaker: THE Devil
script.text: Leave

script.speaker: THE Devil
script.text: The feast is over. The insect has left the room
Ulysses drops the bow. He walks out of the hall, out of the palace, down to the sea. The noise fades. The anxiety lifts.
He looks at the water. It is vast. It is silent.

script.speaker: THE WATER
script.text: Something has begun
, thinks Ulysses.

script.speaker: THE VICTOR
script.text: Quiet. Serene. No anxiety. The high seas
The Parasite remains in the hall, eating the history of the world. But the Host has gone. He has become the Sea.
